label: Log pile
author: Claude (Anthropic), Claude Code cloud session, for Evan
prompt: Rebuild the Ranch Atelier original pack from its write-up: thirteen trees, bushes, rocks and yard props (two oaks, a birch, two firs, two bushes, two boulders, a stump, a log pile, a rain barrel and a crate stack), made from scratch in Blender by a script. Sizes and shapes follow what was measured in Northgard: simple cheap shapes, low full crowns that come almost to the ground, flat boulders about half as tall as wide, and one model repainted per land (meadow, autumn, frost; firs stay green in autumn). Nothing copied. Keep provenance for every model.
referenceStudied: Northgard (Shiro Games), studied for proportion and paint strategy only, via the measurements recorded on the Original Pack page (https://claude.ai/artifact/6aQ47M8cnig6tW8gAxDqsR). No Northgard meshes, textures, screenshots or other files were used as input.
